semantic_content.answer: No. The argument contradicts its own lowest-terms hypothesis: if a and b are both even, then 2 is a common divisor. With the standard well-ordering principle used explicitly to obtain a lowest-denominator representation and to establish parity, the reductio proves that sqrt(2) is irrational, not rational.
